_help: Newest release first. Each user sees the releases newer than the last one they've seen, once. Add a release at the top and bump VERSION in main.py to match. An item with "perm" is only shown to users with that permission (e.g. settings = administrators).

releases.title: Real emergencies, and every radio in the list

items.title: Emergencies straight from the radio
items.text: When a radio's emergency button is pressed, KenTrackIt now reads the emergency the radio sends and raises a single alert at that unit's position, however many ways the radio reports it. When the radio is reset, an "emergency reset" note is added; the emergency stays open until a dispatcher acknowledges it.

items.title: Radios without GPS show up too
items.text: Units that talk but never send a position (like CS and Nate) now appear in the unit list, marked "no GPS · calls only", with when they last called.

items.title: Private calls to dispatch
items.text: Calls made straight to the dispatch ID (an emergency call, for example) are recorded with who they were to.

items.title: Talk to the fleet from your browser
items.text: The new Dispatch page: pick the group or a unit, hold the big button (or Space) and talk. One dispatcher at a time, and it won't talk over a busy channel.

items.title: Listen live
items.text: Hear the channel as it happens on the Dispatch page, with recent calls and their recordings beside it.

items.title: K5TRA or NXR
items.text: Talk through the monitor radio with a K5TRA, or straight into the NXR-1800 over SIP. Set it up under Settings → Dispatch console, along with HTTPS for using the microphone on the office network.

items.title: Emergencies on the console
items.text: An emergency shows across the top of the Dispatch page with a button to talk straight to that unit.

releases.title: Caller ID, front-panel display and more

items.title: Who's calling
items.text: Voice calls now carry the caller's ID and radio name straight from the radio, so the on-air banner, the Channel log and recordings all show who was talking.

items.title: Most Active
items.text: A full-screen leaderboard of the busiest units: distance, time moving, talk time and calls. Open it from Reports.

items.title: Front-panel display
items.text: A 20×4 LCD on the Pi can show who's on air, the last caller and alerts, and flashes for emergencies. Set it up under Settings → Front-panel display.

items.title: Security update
items.text: Tighter protection for the web pages and exports. Nothing for you to do.

items.title: What's New
items.text: This window. It appears once after each update; open it again any time from My account.

releases.title: Voice recording, coverage and channel load

items.title: Voice recording
items.text: Every voice call can be recorded and played back from the map or the Channel page.

items.title: Coverage map
items.text: See where units are heard well and where polls go missing: the coverage button on the map.

items.title: Channel page
items.text: How busy the channel is, hour by hour, and a log of every transmission.

items.title: Who's talking
items.text: The unit on air lights up on the map, with an ON AIR banner at the top.
